memberdef.argsstring: (const FreeAlgebra &A, const ConstPolyList &gb, const std::vector< int > &lo_degree, const std::vector< int > &hi_degree, int limit)
memberdef.name: NCBasis

briefdescription.para: Non-commutative analogue of KBasis: enumerates basis monomials of a FreeAlgebra quotient up to a degree / length bound.

detaileddescription.para: Holds the ambient FreeAlgebra plus the set of generator variables / their heft degrees (mVariables, mVariableHefts), a WordTable of GB lead terms (so monomials divisible by any lead term are skipped), and the recursion scratch state (mMonomial and mCurrentIndex). The recursive worker prefixes each generator in turn and emits a column whenever the partial word reaches the requested target degree.
